entries.text: SSB, AMPLab, TSBS DevOps and TPC-DI data generation now write their delimited files through Apache Arrow in column batches instead of one csv.writer call per row, and the TPC-H-derived primitives staging files (orders_stage, lineitem_stage) are copied with the Arrow CSV reader and writer instead of being parsed and rewritten as Python rows; generated files are byte-identical for the same seed and scale factor, SF1 SSB generation drops from about 58s to 39s and primitives staging from about 3.9s to 0.8s
